name: Mandeep Sidhu
title: Principal Consultant, Digital Transformation Advisory at Schneider Electric
bio: Mandeep is an advocate of a protocol his own company set loose on the world. As Schneider Electric's UK&I Industrial Data Management & AI Lead — Schneider being the home of Modicon, which invented Modbus in 1979 and gave it away for free — he spends his days dragging register-level fieldbus data from Critical National Infrastructure into the age of cloud and AI.
